description: Fetch observation data (date + value pairs) for one or more FRED series over a date range. Supports FRED built-in unit transformations (lin, chg, ch1, pch, pc1, pca, cch, cca, log). Multi-series or >500-row results spill to a DataCanvas table — the response includes a `dataset` field with the handle to query via fedreserve_dataframe_query. Observation values are kept as strings to preserve trailing zeros.

aggregation_method.description: Aggregation method when downsampling frequency: avg, sum, or eop (end of period).

canvas_id.description: Optional canvas ID from a prior fedreserve_get_observations call. Omit to create a fresh table; provide to append to an existing canvas.

frequency.description: Frequency for aggregation downsampling (d=daily, w=weekly, m=monthly, q=quarterly, sa=semi-annual, a=annual). Must not be higher than the native series frequency.

observation_end.description: End date for observations (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the series end.

observation_start.description: Start date for observations (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the series start.

anyOf.description: Array of up to 10 series IDs.

series_ids.description: One series ID or an array of up to 10 series IDs.

units.description: Unit transformation: lin=levels, chg=change, ch1=change from year ago, pch=percent change, pc1=percent change from year ago, pca=compounded annual rate, cch=continuously compounded rate, cca=continuously compounded annual rate, log=natural log.

name: fedreserve_get_observations

dataset.description: Canvas dataset handle — present when results spilled to canvas (multi-series or >500 rows). Pass `name` to fedreserve_dataframe_query for SQL access.

name.description: Canvas table name (df_XXXXX_XXXXX). Pass to fedreserve_dataframe_query.

preview_rows.description: Number of rows shown inline in the observations arrays.

row_count.description: Total rows registered in the canvas table.

truncated.description: True when the canvas table is a subset of available data.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `series_not_found`: A series ID is not found on FRED. `frequency_too_high`: Requested frequency aggregation is higher than the series native frequency. `no_observations_in_range`: Valid series but the date range contains no observations. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: Series that failed to fetch, with per-ID error details.

items.description: A failed series fetch with its error.

message.description: Informational note — present when canvas is unavailable or results were truncated.

observation_count.description: Number of observations for this series.

observation_end.description: Actual end date of observations returned.

observation_start.description: Actual start date of observations returned.

observations.description: Inline observations (all rows for short single-series; preview for spilled).

value.description: Observation value as a string (preserves trailing zeros; "." for missing).

total_observations.description: Total observation count across all series.

title: Get FRED Series Observations
